question: Did the Partner channel's share of completed orders go up from 2024 to 2025? If it did, give Partner's 2025 completed orders by region. If it did not, give the 2025 completed orders by region for whichever channel's share rose the most.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH channel_shares AS (SELECT o.channel, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2025, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date <= '2024-12-31') AS total_2024, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31') AS total_2025 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel), channel_diffs AS (SELECT channel, (CAST(count_2025 AS REAL) / total_2025) - (CAST(count_2024 AS REAL) / total_2024) AS share_diff FROM channel_shares), target_channel AS (SELECT channel FROM channel_shares WHERE channel = 'Partner' AND (CAST(count_2025 AS REAL) / total_2025) > (CAST(count_2024 AS REAL) / total_2024) UNION SELECT (SELECT channel FROM channel_diffs ORDER BY share_diff DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM channel_shares WHERE channel = 'Partner' AND (CAST(count_2025 AS REAL) / total_2025) > (CAST(count_2024 AS REAL) / total_2024))) SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_orders_2025 FROM regions AS r LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.channel = (SELECT channel FROM target_channel) AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY completed_orders_2025 DESC
